evidence: Integrates functional test discovery into the CMake build system (`CMakeLists.txt`, `test/functional/CMakeLists.txt`) and modifies CI test scripts (`ci/test/03_test_script.sh`).
rationale: Enables opt-in CTest orchestration of Python functional tests and exercises it in native macOS CI. As author notes, this allows CI and developers to "use the same standard CTest interface to run all unit and enabled functional tests" with standard filtering and IDE integration, providing useful contributor tooling without resolving an urgent platform or CI failure.
